entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return an item. Order number is 788-B-451.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered October 17th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. It's just too tight. I need to get a return or an exchange started. Just tell me if I can do it.
Understood. Thank you for clarifying that it's a sizing issue. One moment while I check the policy for that item.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you. I have just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can use that for a full refund or to initiate an exchange for a different size on our website.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
